parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of target instance. You can call [DescribeInstances](~~144595~~) to obtain target instance ID.

parameters.name: CoreInstanceType
parameters.description:
The new node specifications of the core node. You can invoke [DescribeInstanceType](~~145796~~) to obtain the available node specifications.

> You must specify either the MasterInstanceType parameter or the CoreInstanceType parameter.

parameters.name: MasterInstanceType
parameters.description:
The new node specifications of the master node. You can invoke [DescribeInstanceType](~~145796~~) to obtain the available node specifications.

> You must specify either the MasterInstanceType parameter or the CoreInstanceType parameter.
